verdict.rationale: Paychex markets 'AI-powered compliance support' that answers questions and generates HR documents. That implies a first-party natural-language interface for a narrow slice of the product. Nothing shows natural-language commands driving core operations such as running payroll, updating employee records, or approving time off; the 'AI-suggested Modifications' feature is a suggestion engine, not command-driven operation. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of core payroll/HR actions, details on the assistant's scope and actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
